correctness.rationale: In A=kQ/J², J denotes the image of the arrow ideal and is the radical. Since J²=0, the Peirce action on J only depends on idempotents modulo J. Thus the induced vertex permutation must preserve all block dimensions; conversely any such permutation lifts by block isomorphisms. For an automorphism in the kernel, f_v=φ(e_v) are orthogonal lifts; u=Σ_v f_v e_v≡1 mod J is invertible and f_vu=ue_v. After conjugating by u⁻¹ only the independent GL actions on the arrow blocks remain. Conjugation by 1+J is normal and has kernel 1+(Z(A)∩J). Projecting along the Peirce blocks shows that Z(A)∩J is exactly the diagonal loop subspace, including for arbitrary loop combinations; a map from 1+J fixing all e_v acts trivially. This gives the stated semidirect product and order, including disconnected and isolated vertices and the GL_0 convention. Hand checks include one vertex with r loops, giving GL_r with no additive factor, and one arrow, giving q(q−1). The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed.
